q: What did METR measure as the “time horizon” of AI agents?
options: The length of tasks, in human expert time, that agents complete at a given reliability
explain: Horizons are tied to a success-rate threshold, often 50%.

q: What trend did METR report in 2025?
options: The length of tasks models complete at 50% success doubling roughly every seven months

q: At 95% success per step, roughly how often does a 10-step task succeed?
Why is a 50% task horizon not the same as delegable work?
options: Half of those tasks fail; production needs high reliability across runs
